morphology.pattern_note: 现代构词中按完整词基处理，不把 bia- 当作词缀；加 ber- 构成 berbiasiswa，表示拥有奖学金。

senses.zh_definition: 奖学金；发给学生、用于支付或补助其学习费用的资助款项。
senses.en_definition: A scholarship: money awarded to a student to cover or help cover educational expenses.
senses.ms_definition: Wang yang diberikan kepada pelajar untuk membiayai atau membantu membiayai pelajarannya, biasanya di maktab atau di universiti.
senses.nuances: 既可译为奖学金，也可按具体项目译为助学性质的奖学金；不能仅凭词本身断定只奖励成绩优秀者，或必定涵盖全部费用。与须偿还的 pinjaman pelajaran 应按项目性质区分。马来语释义依据输入包及 [DBP 词条 biasiswa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=234664&keyword=biasiswa)。

dual_scenarios.context: 教育公告 / 大学资助通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Pelajar yang memenuhi syarat boleh memohon biasiswa ini melalui portal rasmi universiti.
dual_scenarios.zh: 符合条件的学生可通过大学官方门户网站申请这项奖学金。
dual_scenarios.en: Eligible students may apply for this scholarship through the university's official portal.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友分享申请结果
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah dapat biasiswa tu, lega betul!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendapat biasiswa itu. Saya berasa sangat lega.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我拿到那项奖学金了，总算松口气！
dual_scenarios.en: I got that scholarship. What a relief!
spoken_features: lega betul：口语中加强如释重负的语气

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah dapat biasiswa tu! Baru dapat e-mel tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendapat biasiswa itu. Saya baru menerima e-mel sebentar tadi.
messages.zh: 我拿到那项奖学金了！刚刚收到邮件。
messages.en: I got that scholarship! The email just came through.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Wah, tahniah! Dah beritahu mak ayah ke?
messages.ms_standard: Wah, tahniah! Adakah kamu sudah memberitahu ibu bapa kamu?
messages.en: Wow, congratulations! Have you told your parents yet?

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian educational life, biasiswa names financial support that can open a route to further study. DBP's encyclopedic account describes awards connected with achievement, ability, or financial need, so the word carries both recognition and opportunity. This cultural history helps explain its importance to students and families; the consulted entry does not establish the word's exact formation or first use. [DBP encyclopedia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=biasiswa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用语义联想记：想到学生 siswa 的学习费用 mendapat bantuan，便想到 biasiswa；这是记忆提示，不是已核实的词源拆分。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 听到别人获得奖学金，可以说 Tahniah!；涉及资助金额或家庭经济情况，先尊重对方是否愿意分享。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于教育公告、申请材料和日常交流。不要把所有 biasiswa 都称为贫困补助，也不要由获奖情况推断对方的家庭收入。
